## Assignment Options

::: {.callout-note title="Mechanics Focus"}
The base problem models the exposed 20 mm × 20 mm tool-holder shank as a prismatic cantilever under a transverse passive/radial tip force. It evaluates elastic radial deflection and its diameter-error contribution. Stress design, chatter, thermal effects, and complete machine-system compliance are intentionally excluded.
:::
